extDescription.message: Lets Claude Code and other MCP clients drive this browser through a local MCP server. No account sign-in needed.

stopSent.message: Stop sent; the agent halts before its next step.

stopFailed.message: The stop request did not get through. Interrupt the agent in your client instead (Esc in Claude Code).

connectFailed.message: Cannot reach $URL$ (is the MCP server running?)

waitingServer.message: Waiting for the MCP server. It starts together with your MCP client, such as Claude Code.

groupHint.message: Only tabs in the “Browser Bridge” tab group can be controlled. You can also drag a tab into that group.

aiLead.message: Used by find. With an OpenAI-compatible endpoint filled in, a model reads natural-language queries such as “the button that places the order”; leave it empty to use local keyword matching.

aiBaseUrlHelp.message: An OpenAI-compatible API, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1. A bare host gets /v1 added; a full …/chat/completions URL works too.

aiApiKeyHelp.message: Stored only in this browser. Leave it empty for local models such as Ollama.

aiModelHelp.message: A model name the endpoint accepts, e.g. gpt-4o-mini

aiPrivacy.message: When enabled, find sends the structure of the current page (password, verification-code and card fields are masked) to the endpoint above.

modeKeyword.message: Now: find uses local keyword matching

errScheme.message: The endpoint must start with http:// or https://.

errNeedConfig.message: Fill in the endpoint and model first.

cleared.message: Cleared; find will use local keyword matching.

saved.message: Saved. find will use AI matching; press “Test connection” to make sure it works.

humanTypingHelp.message: Types one character at a time with a random pause of a few dozen milliseconds (long text speeds up so each entry finishes within about 12 seconds). Some sites treat instant input as a bot and show a CAPTCHA; turn this off for faster typing.

humanTypingOn.message: On: typing follows a human rhythm.

humanTypingOff.message: Off: text is entered all at once.
